tenancy.title: Send a written request for the deposit
tenancy.note: Your biggest gap. Give him 7 days to reply. The draft uses only your facts and your agreement.

tenancy.title: Gather what is missing
tenancy.note: Stamp duty certificate, signed inventory list, final bill, dated move-in photos.

tenancy.title: Pre-filing assessment on CJTS
tenancy.note: Pick the category, enter the refusal date and the amount, answer the questions. The ID it gives you lasts 7 days.

tenancy.title: Fill the claim form and pay
tenancy.note: Six parts: you, him, the claim, a summary of at most 500 characters, documents (PDF only, 5MB each, with page numbers), money order. Singpass login. Then pick a Consultation date.

tenancy.title: Serve him within 7 working days
tenancy.note: Save the Respondent Copy from CJTS, hand it to him or send by registered post, then file the Declaration of Service.

tenancy.title: Before the Consultation
tenancy.note: He may open e-Negotiation (5 rounds). Fill the Submission for Hearing form: events in date order, witnesses. Bring E1 to E6 in evidence sheet order.

goods.title: Send a written request to the seller
goods.note: Say what is wrong, what you want (refund, repair or replacement) and a date to reply by.

goods.title: Gather what is missing
goods.note: Receipt, listing, dated photos of the fault, a repair quote.

goods.title: Pre-filing assessment on CJTS
goods.note: Pick the category, enter the date and the amount, answer the questions. The ID it gives you lasts 7 days.

goods.title: Fill the claim form and pay
goods.note: Six parts: you, the seller, the claim, a summary of at most 500 characters, documents (PDF only, 5MB each, with page numbers), money order. Singpass login.

goods.title: Serve the seller within 7 working days
goods.note: Save the Respondent Copy from CJTS, hand it over or send by registered post, then file the Declaration of Service.

goods.title: Before the Consultation
goods.note: The seller may open e-Negotiation (5 rounds). Fill the Submission for Hearing form: events in date order, witnesses.
